ctx.x: Oh he was a great arranger. I think he committed suicide later. But I mean who knows what his other problems were, but he could sure write. And he wrote for that band and we had, I know I was there, John Ewing the trombone player and I don’t think Lucky was there, maybe Teddy Edwards or somebody, but what a band. And then Mingus did some early stuff too for I don’t know what record was it — I’ve got the tape at home by the way, I should remember it.
You were pretty much one of the first black musicians to get into the studios.
